name: Hexagon AEON
summary: A 1.65 m, 60 kg industrial humanoid on wheeled legs with self-swapping battery, in pilots at BMW Leipzig and Schaeffler in Germany.

germany.statusNote: Hexagon Robotics (Zurich) sells to industrial companies on request via its contact form. Documented German users: BMW Plant Leipzig (production tasks since June 2026) and Schaeffler (pilot 2025, at least 1,000 units planned by 2032, rollout from end of 2026). No public price; so far units go to industrial partners.

sellers.name: Hexagon Robotics (Hexagon AB division)
sellers.note: Contact form with company and country fields; Germany listed.

specs.label: Swappable battery
specs.conditions: Robot swaps its own battery for continuous work

specs.label: Sensors
specs.value: Multimodal sensor suite with Hexagon measurement and 3D spatial intelligence

notes: Moves on wheels (Hexagon summary of a FAZ report from BMW Leipzig: the wheels are expected to make it faster and cut energy use for longer operating times); the product page only names a "unique locomotion system".
Auto battery swap allows continuous operation.
Payload 15 kg short-term, 8 kg constant carry; not stated per arm.
Built for factory floors; no stair, outdoor or IP data published.
